name: agent-letter-verify
description: 离线核对代理信件的结构、发件人白名单、正文摘要和 HMAC；明确区分通过、拒绝与未校验，不发送信件。
scope: Explicit offline verification of the supported whale-post-basic-v1 JSON envelope profile using local per-sender keys. Linux/macOS, Python >=3.11 standard library plus the host SDK; no transport, automatic WorkSwarm interception, replay defense, unique-author identity proof or secret output.
